gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
Looking back ___ it, the risk was worth taking.
gaps.explanation: look back ON something = remember and think about the past.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
The store decided to branch ___ into online sales.
gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.
